engineUnreachable: The engine could not be reached ({detail}) — it may still be starting, or it stopped. The status light in the sidebar shows its current state.
engineTimeout: This took longer than {seconds} seconds, so the app stopped waiting. The engine may still be working — if a model had to load first, trying again is usually much quicker.
homeRefreshFailed: Could not load your videos. The engine answered but the list request failed — retrying.
engineCrashedDetail: Your work is still here — nothing was lost. Start the engine again to carry on.
engineRestartSlow: Still going. After a crash the engine's port can stay reserved by the system for up to a minute — the app keeps trying until it frees up.
engineCopyReportHint: Versions, this machine, and the engine's last output. Copied to your clipboard — nothing is sent anywhere.
crashReportNoOutput: the engine produced no output before it stopped
templateLimit: That's the {limit}-template limit. Delete one from "Start from a template…" first.
templateSize: This project's shape is too large to keep as a template.
templateMissing: That template is no longer saved on this machine.
noGeneratedKeyframe: This scene has no generated picture to go back to, so its photo cannot be removed.
